scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure
scenarios.reasoning: The agent successfully identified the core nature of the failure (F# compilation errors in HotReload test files) and provided useful categorization of error types. However, it missed identifying all failing projects (only named one of two) and completely missed the target framework dimension. The execution had some inefficiency with failed file path lookups, but the agent recovered by using the limit parameter on the errors tool. The final output is partially correct but incomplete.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files
